name: Synkov-Slemeno (Czechia)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and red, with three yellow flowers one above the other in the blue and a yellow wheat sheaf with a yellow flower in the red.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 20 January 2005 (decision No. 50) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
